items.quote: I’m assisting in finding the ideal candidate for their Recruiter role.
items.statement: An agency is looking for a candidate for a Recruiter role.

items.quote: We’re looking for someone with real estate sales experience who is confident, driven, and ready to learn and grow in recruitment.
items.statement: The ideal candidate should have real estate sales experience, confidence, and a willingness to learn.

items.quote: understands that modern recruitment is a sales role at its core.
items.statement: Modern recruitment is described as a sales role at its core.

items.quote: Build strong business relationships with agents.
items.statement: The candidate will build strong business relationships with agents.

items.quote: but it requires the same energy, focus, and persistence as sales.
items.statement: The role requires energy, focus, and persistence similar to sales.

items.quote: DM me your CV, and let’s discuss if this role is the right fit for you.
items.statement: Candidates must DM their CV to discuss the role.

overview: LinkedIn post detailing a job opportunity for a recruiter role.
